message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "enforce_imaging_tool_invocation", "description": "When a task involves interpreting medical images or generating reports from imaging data, the agent must invoke the designated imaging tools instead of relying on internal knowledge or hallucinating findings.", "applicable_conditions": "The user query explicitly or implicitly requires analysis of medical imaging data (e.g., X-ray, CT, MRI) or the generation of a radiology report based on such images.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier", "chest_xray_report_generator"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If the task requires interpreting an image or generating an imaging report: (1) Immediately invoke the appropriate imaging analysis tool (e.g., `chest_xray_classifier` for classification/detection); (2) Use the output from the analysis tool to inform the subsequent report generation tool (e.g., `chest_xray_report_generator`). Do NOT attempt to answer based on clinical text alone or hallucinate image findings without tool evidence."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
